review_candidates.title: Lead Embedded Firmware & Electronics Engineer — Wearables (BLE, Ultra-Low-Power)
review_candidates.description: About Lumysi Lumysi is a US-based wearable technology startup developing a jewelry-inspired health and fitness bracelet. Our screenless titanium wearable continuously tracks health, activity, sleep, recovery, and women's health metrics while keeping the look and comfort of a premium accessory. The product combines biometric sensors, ultra-low-power embedded systems, Bluetooth connectivity, interchangeable straps, and a mobile app that turns health data into personalized insights. The Role We are hiring a senior engineer to own the firmware and the hardware/firmware integration of the Lumysi wearable end to end, from bring-up of new prototype boards through production release. You will be the technical reference for embedded development. You will set the firmware architecture, make the hard trade-offs between battery life, sensor quality and connectivity, and raise the bar for a growing engineering team. This is a hands-on role. You will write production C/C++ every week, work at the bench with a scope and a power profiler, and collaborate directly with the founders, hardware engineers, the mobile team, sensor suppliers and contract manufacturers. What You'll Own • Firmware architecture on Nordic (nRF52/nRF53) and Espressif platforms: RTOS design (Zephyr/nRF Connect SDK or FreeRTOS), task model, memory, boot flow and modularity. • Bring-up of new board revisions, working from schematics and datasheets: clocks, power rails, memories, sensors, PMIC and peripherals. • The device power budget. You will implement sleep modes, wake-up sources, sensor duty-cycling and BLE connection parameters to reach multi-day battery life, and validate them at µA level with power-profiling tools. • Biometric acquisition: drivers and pipelines for PPG, IMU and skin-temperature sensors, covering sampling strategy, FIFO/buffering, timestamping and data quality under motion. • BLE: custom GATT services, reliable sync of stored data to iOS/Android, connection robustness and sniffer-based debugging. You will also work with hardware on RF/antenna performance inside a titanium enclosure. Battery and charging: PMIC, charger and fuel-gauge integration, battery protection and accurate state-of-charge reporting. • Security and updates: secure boot, signed OTA/DFU with rollback, secure element integration, and PKI-based device identity and provisioning. • Manufacturing: factory test firmware, calibration, provisioning flows and production-line support with our contract manufacturer. • Engineering discipline: code reviews, coding standards, CI, hardware-in-the-loop testing, release management and documentation. You will also mentor and unblock other engineers on the team. • The firmware perspective in schematic reviews, component selection and design for testability. Must-Have • 7+ years of professional embedded development in C/C++ on resource-constrained MCUs, both bare-metal and RTOS. • Firmware lead or primary firmware owner of at least one battery-powered, BLE-connected product that shipped to volume production. You have lived through EVT, DVT, PVT and post-launch field issues, and can walk us through them in detail. • Deep BLE experience: GATT design, connection and advertising tuning, throughput vs. power trade-offs, and iOS/Android interoperability. • Proven ultra-low-power optimization on real hardware, backed by measurements. • Strong electronics fundamentals. You read schematics and layouts confidently, understand power rails, analog front-ends and noise, and can tell whether a bug lives in hardware or firmware. • Board-level debugging with JTAG/SWD, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, BLE sniffers and power analyzers. • Sensor drivers over I2C, SPI and UART, plus interrupts, DMA, timers and ADCs. • Git, CI and structured testing, with Python for test tooling and automation. • Professional working proficiency in English, and comfort working directly with founders and external partners in a fast-moving startup. Strong Plus • Wearable, medical or consumer devices with biometric sensors (PPG, SpO₂, IMU, skin temperature), including signal quality, calibration and motion artifacts. • Zephyr / nRF Connect SDK and MCUboot in production. • Embedded security: secure elements, secure boot, cryptographic provisioning. • RF/antenna tuning in compact or metal enclosures, FCC/IC/CE pre-compliance and Bluetooth SIG qualification. • Production ramp with contract manufacturers. • Experience as a founding or first senior engineer at an early-stage hardware startup. What We Offer • Ownership of the firmware and embedded architecture of an international wearable product. • Direct collaboration with the founders, engineering team and manufacturing partners. • Real decision-making power from day one: your choices ship.

review_candidates.title: FGSES - Assistant / Associate Professor of International Relations
review_candidates.description: About UM6P Mohammed VI Polytechnic University is an institution dedicated to research and innovation in Africa and aims to position itself among world-renowned universities in its fields The University is engaged in economic and human development and puts research and innovation at the forefront of African development. A mechanism that enables it to consolidate Morocco's frontline position in these fields, in a unique partnership-based approach and boosting skills training relevant for the future of Africa. Located in the municipality of Benguerir, in the very heart of the Green City, Mohammed VI Polytechnic University aspires to leave its mark nationally, continentally, and globally. About FGSES The Social Sciences, Economics, and Humanities Cluster at Mohammed VI Polytechnic University (UM6P) is a dynamic ecosystem dedicated to navigating the complexities of a rapidly evolving, digital world. Uniting five core disciplines, we bridge knowledge creation, education, and policymaking through three collaborative entities: AIRESS (research), FGSES (academic education), and the Public Policy School (executive training), alongside SCALES for innovative pedagogy. Guided by a "New South" perspective, we rethink the social sciences to address Africa’s unique challenges while providing global solutions. We embrace technology to enhance the profoundly human dimensions of knowledge, offering a vibrant, diverse environment for researchers, educators, and policymakers to shape the leaders of tomorrow. Area: International organization / multilateralism Deadline: December 15, 2026 Job location: Rabat, Morocco Salary: Competitive The Faculty of Governance, Economics and Social Sciences (FGSES) at Mohammed VI Polytechnic University (UM6P) invites applications for a position at the Assistant or Associate Professor level in International Relations, beginning in Autumn 2027. While we are open to various subfields of IR, we are particularly interested in scholars who specialize in international organization / multilateralism. The search is open with respect to substantive and regional focus, keeping in mind that FGSES has particular strengths in studies of African cases. Candidates should have a strong research agenda and demonstrated potential for excellence in scholarship and teaching. Applicants must hold a Ph.D. in International Relations, Political Science, Government, or a closely related field in the social sciences, or expect to complete the degree by August 2027. An appointment at the Associate Professor level will be with tenure; an appointment at the Assistant Professor level will be tenure-track. UM6P faculty may teach their courses in French or English. The successful candidate will likely be asked to teach international relations courses outside their immediate area of specialization. The standard teaching load is two courses per semester. The Social Sciences, Economics, and Humanities cluster at UM6P is only ten years old but has already assembled a distinguished international faculty and a vibrant community of undergraduate, master’s, and doctoral students across five disciplines. Its campus in Rabat, Morocco’s capital, features striking architecture and brings together a public policy school, a think tank, and a major research incubator. In the 2026 Times Higher Education World University Rankings, UM6P ranks among the world’s top 400 universities. UM6P offers salaries and benefits that are competitive with those at many North American and European universities, as well as an annual performance bonus and substantial support for research. Applicants Should Submit A detailed curriculum vitae, including a complete list of publications; Two recent writing samples; and For applicants at the Assistant Professor level, three letters of recommendation, to be submitted directly to pol.recruitment@um6p.ma. For the full job posting and to apply online, please use the following link: https://recruitment.fgses-um6p.ma/ The application deadline is December 15, 2026. UM6P does not discriminate on the basis of religion, race, gender, age, disability, or national or ethnic origin.
